status: REVIEW DERIVATIVE — an afro for the Northstar v2 head from the full-resolution R2 afro original; not approved, not an R3 production asset, not promotable

source.provenance: D-111's generated afro candidate (gpt-image-2-2026-04-21, delivered at 1024x1536, achromatic luminance + alpha), alpha-cleaned and owner-approved at render scale, tracked by D-113 beside the untouched raw afro-original.png (14a037a0…). The served R2 webp (hair-afro-v1.webp) is its ÷2 downscale.
source.resolutionEvidence: a ÷2 box downscale of it matches the webp decode (mean |Δ| 0.70 grey+alpha); the detail lost by ÷2 + bilinear ×2 is 4.08 against 1.72 for a known ×2 upscale of the 512 decode — it holds real detail beyond 512x768, so it is the full-resolution original, not an upscale

baseline.head: the D-191 bald head (unchanged): its brows, face, ears and canvas are the fit

placement.rule: one uniform scale + translation of the 1024x1536 original (v2 = s·(x + 0.5) + t, bilinear on premultiplied grey + alpha): centred on the face axis and 8 px below the canvas top, so nothing is cut
placement.why: s 0.86 keeps the volume of the owner-approved R2 afro (D-113 placed it at ÷2 of this file in R2's space; D-191's best fit was 0.858 in this file's scale); the head, the brows and the avatar keep their scale — only the hair is placed

hairline.rule: a smooth radial displacement field (centre (511.5, 330)) moves the afro's own inner hairline out of the face to a target superellipse |x/122|^3 + |y/125|^3 = 1 about that centre — high over the brows (top y 205), steeply down just outside the brow tips (x ≈ 394 / 629 at y 270), close to the face edge at the temples. The shift per angle is the target minus the DEEPEST scallop within ±4° (so every scallop clears the brows), smoothed over the angle; the full shift applies up to the hairline band and falls linearly to 0 at the afro's outer silhouette, which stays where it is. Nothing is cut: the curls, their scallops and their soft edge move together. Above the ear line only (full up to y 360, none from y 400).

backHair.rule: NEW DRAWN CONTENT, documented: a back-hair fill BEHIND the head, only in the D-191 head's own slits — pixels inside a 3 px closing of its silhouette that are neither head nor opaque afro, in the ear band y 300–430 (the 1–2 px gap between ear and face below the D-189 ear-root wedge, y ≈ 340–380, through which the background would show). Filled harmonically from the adjacent opaque afro grey (the shadowed inside of the afro); never drawn on the face or over the hair. The notch between ear lobe and jaw is NOT filled: an earlier iteration closed it and drew hard, flat dark blocks below the hair; background showing there is natural (as with short).

shadow: none. Northstar's cast shadow belongs to its fringe, which lies on the forehead; this afro's hairline sits above the forehead with no hanging lock, so a cast shadow would be new drawn content without a source. Left out deliberately, documented as an open point.
tint: the derivative keeps R2's grey luminance + alpha; review images tint it as the R2 runtime does (token base × luminance; brown #5A3D28)
